features.name: pm25_lag_1..24
features.definition: regional PM2.5, newest value at issue time minus 2 h, 24 hourly lags

features.name: fire_count_box_{a,b,c}
features.definition: MODIS detections in the source box over the hours visible at issue time minus 3 h

features.name: rain_{6,24}h_box_{a,b,c}
features.definition: sum of IMERG Early rain over the last 6 and 24 h; any missing half hour gives missing; latency 4 h

features.name: era5_wind_rain_blh
features.definition: corridor-mean 10 m wind, 850 hPa wind, total precipitation; reanalysis

limitations: Singapore PM2.5 is five NEA regions, not stations; the label start or end of hour is not stated.
Stage P results come from blocked folds inside one season and carry no skill claim.
The shift null in Experiment A has 31 shifts; no test can reach supported_association (Amendment 1).
Latencies for FIRMS, IMERG and SMAP are nominal values, not measured per file.
I1 ran on the 2015 season only. Other seasons of IMERG Early were not downloaded.
The 2015 negative ablation (30.76, 32.10, 36.73, 41.75) is a separate result and is not mixed with M5 numbers.
claims_not_made: No causal attribution of Singapore PM2.5 to specific fires.
No operational forecast and no health advice.
No sealed NEA data (from 2024-01-01) was read.
period: 2015-09-01 to 2015-10-31 (haze, main); 2016 clean season; 2019 held-out haze season; NEA before 2024-01-01
